voice.caption: Athena's mist falls away only when Odysseus reaches Arete.

voice.speaker: odysseus
voice.caption: Arete, daughter of Rhexenor, after many trials I come to your knees, and to your king, and to all these feasters. May the gods give you long joy. For me, ask only this: grant me convoy to my own country, for I have suffered long, far from everyone I love.

voice.speaker: echeneus
voice.caption: Alcinous, this is not well, and it does not befit you: a stranger sitting in the ashes of your hearth. Raise him up, seat him on a silver-studded chair, and let the herald mix wine, for Zeus himself walks with suppliants.

voice.speaker: odysseus
voice.caption: Odysseus is seated beside the king, fed, and promised a convoy home.
